questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code scopes and replays idempotent ride requests? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
How long is a saved ride response eligible for replay?
choices: For 24 hours after it is saved, then a repeat request dispatches a new ride
Forever, because entries are never deleted
Only while the original request context is alive

questions.prompt: Dispatcher.Assign returns an error because no drivers are available. The rider retries with the same key a few seconds later. What happens?
choices: The retry replays the 503 from the cache
The retry returns 409 because the key is in use
The retry attempts to dispatch again, because failures are not saved
The retry is rejected because the key was already consumed

questions.prompt: Which concurrency hazard exists for two simultaneous requests with the same key from the same rider?
choices: A data race on the map, because Lookup uses only a read lock
A deadlock between Lookup and Save
None: the RWMutex serializes the whole handler
Both may miss in Lookup before either calls Save, and both dispatch rides
